sloka: ते भक्षयन्तो मूलानि फलानि विविधानि अपि ।अन्वेषमाणा दुर्धर्षा न्यवसन् तत्र तत्र ह ॥४-४८-५॥
transliteration: te bhakṣayanto mūlāni phalāni vividhāni api ।anveṣamāṇā durdharṣā nyavasan tatra tatra ha ॥4-48-5॥

translations.english: The unassailable monkeys ate roots and fruits and halted here and there at different places searching for Sita.
